candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is CA-MRSA sepsis with septic vasculopathy as the primary diagnostic entity. Multifocal septic emboli in the brain (confirmed on MRI) represent a complication/manifestation of that systemic infection. C001 captures only one organ-level finding and omits the causative organism (MRSA), the sepsis syndrome, and the cutaneous vasculopathy components required by the benchmark.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Septic emboli to the brain is one manifestation/complication of the systemic CA-MRSA sepsis with septic vasculopathy, not the overarching diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis is a composite requiring pathogen identity (CA-MRSA), systemic state (sepsis), and vascular skin pathology (septic vasculopathy); single-organ manifestation candidates will systematically fall short
